title: The Man Who Pointed Before the Collapse

story_profile.central_question: Why was the man pointing at a building that collapsed twelve minutes later?

idea.title: The Man Who Pointed Before the Collapse
idea.premise: A city camera records a man pointing at a building twelve minutes before it collapses.
idea.audience_promise: Follow the warning from the street to the recovered frame that turns the disaster into a personal threat.
idea.central_question: Why was the man pointing at a building that collapsed twelve minutes later?

truth.disclosure: This episode is an original fictional suspense story; licensed stock footage is used as declared visual representation.

causal_chain.cause: A man points at an empty building while a city camera records him.
escalation: The entrance is locked and the building appears completely empty.
The same presence appears inside without a visible entrance.
The recording finds no physical evidence before the building collapses.
causal_chain.consequence: A recovered frame shows a hand pressed against glass after the building is gone.
causal_chain.why_it_mattered: The camera turns on again inside another building the next morning, moving the threat from the location to the viewer.

promise_payoff.promise: The opening promises an explanation for the man's warning.
promise_payoff.payoff: The recovered frame and next-morning recurrence reveal that the warning was not about the building alone.

editorial.notes: Hook, escalation, recovered-frame payoff and recurrence are causally linked.

factual.notes: Fiction mode is explicit; source footage is never presented as proof of a real collapse.

monetization.notes: No graphic violence, harmful instruction or real-world allegation is used.
